description: This file provides test support utilities for WebSocket communication in a Gateway WebSocket context, including mock WebSocket tasks, message handling, and methods to generate test data and simulate responses for unit tests.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock WebSocket task used for testing WebSocket interactions, supporting send, receive, and state management.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session that creates and manages GatewayTestWebSocketTask instances for testing WebSocket sessions.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: A test extension to WebSocketTasking that provides a resilient ping method that does nothing but invoke the handler.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates test Data representing a connection challenge message with a nonce.

methods.name: connectRequestID(from:)
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a connection request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Creates a successful connection response Data with the specified ID.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Creates an error response Data indicating authentication failure, with optional details.

methods.name: requestID(from:)
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message, if it is a request.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Creates a simple success response Data with the given ID.
